question.problem: Find the greatest common divisor of $627$ and $456.$
question.worked_solution:
We use the Euclidean algorithm, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}627 & = & 456(1) & + & 171 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 456 & = & 171(2) & + & 114 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 171 & = & 114(1) & + & 57 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 114 & = & 57(2) & + & 0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The last positive remainder is $57.$ Therefore, we conclude that the greatest common divisor of $627$ and $456$ is $57.$ Symbolically, we write

$$
\text{gcd}(627,456)=57.
$$
